package.description: Creator Tool for Coding, AI, AR-VR and Robotics

en-US.description: Creator Tool for Coding, AI, AR-VR and Robotics
en-US.longDescription: PictoBlox is an educational programming software with block-based coding and Python Programming that makes coding fun and easy. With a user-friendly interface and drag-and-drop functionality, it is the ideal companion for setting the first step into the world of programming. One can learn to code, make interactive animations and games, interesting projects based on IoT, program actions for robots, create Artificial Intelligence or Machine Learning projects (like face expression detection, self driving car, object identifier, or speech recognition), and much more!
en-US.name: PictoBlox

zh-CN.description: 编程、AI、AR-VR 与机器人技术的创造者工具
zh-CN.longDescription: PictoBlox 是一款寓教于乐的教育编程软件，融合积木式编程与 Python 语言，让编程学习变得简单有趣。其直观的拖拽式操作界面，是初学者踏入编程世界的理想伙伴。通过该平台，你可以学习编程基础、制作互动动画与游戏、开发物联网趣味项目、为机器人编写动作指令，还能创建人工智能与机器学习项目（如表情识别、自动驾驶汽车、物体识别或语音识别等），探索无限可能！
